Tess (CS): Heads up - HorizonRetail just crossed 78% of monthly credits after a weekend POC run. QBR in 8 days. Theyre worried about surprise charges. Need a crisp mitigation + renewal narrative.
Omar (AE): Do we know which flows caused the spike?
Tess (CS): Preliminary: interactive chat sessions increased and their nightly catalog generation doubled token length after enabling verbose descriptions.
Rina (Solutions Eng): Quick mitigations: 1) cap context length for standard support flows, 2) switch nightly catalog to a condensed template, 3) enable response sampling for non-critical generations.
SpendBot: alert: account_usage.horizonretail > 75% monthly_credits (triggered at 2898761240).
Ezra (Finance): If they hit 95% pre-renewal, they'll push hard on price. Need a projection table with and without mitigations.
Omar (AE): Customer prefers no hard limits. Can we offer an "opt-in week-of-cycle soft cap" and a commit-based discount?
Rina (Solutions Eng): Yes. Proposed soft-cap rule (Console):
```yaml
name: horizon-soft-weekcap
scope: org:horizonretail
window: last_7_days
trigger: projected_monthly > tier_limit
action: throttle_to: 0.6
notify: [tess@redwood.com, omar@redwood.com]
opt_in: true
```
Tess (CS): I'll request they opt into the soft-cap for the remainder of the cycle and run an enablement call to walk through tradeoffs.
ProdUXBot: feature_request: Horizon requested per-route cost breakdown in Console and a preview of projected month-end spend. Logged as FR-7091.
Ezra (Finance): For the QBR one-pager use 3 scenarios: baseline (no change), mitigations-only (capping + condensed template), and mitigations + 12mo commit (include proposed credits). Assume mitigations cut generation tokens by ~28% conservatively.
Omar (AE): I'll draft the one-pager and include an exec summary: root cause, actions taken, projected spend delta, recommended commit.
Rina (Solutions Eng): Quick snippet to reduce catalog verbosity in their generator template (replace lengthy bullet expansion with concise attributes):
```text
From: "Describe product in 500+ words with use cases."
To: "Summarize product as 3 short bullets (50-80 chars each)."
```
Tess (CS): Scheduling: runbook + opt-in flow review tomorrow 10am PT with Horizon SREs. I'll capture feedback and add to the QBR appendix.
Ezra (Finance): I'll drop a spend table and compute a suggested credit level that still preserves margin.
Omar (AE): Action list: Omar - one-pager & renewal ask; Tess - opt-in runbook & feedback capture; Rina - template and policy PR; Ezra - spend scenarios and credit math.
Tess (CS): Also noting product feedback: a customer-visible projected spend preview would make these convos smoother. I'll escalate with ProdUXBot.
SpendBot: note: ticket CS-9022 created to track Horizon mitigation and QBR artifacts.
Tess (CS): I'll post the draft one-pager and graphs here after the runbook call. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
Rina (Solutions Eng): After 30m in staging with the condensed template we saw ~22% token reduction on a sample export. Good signal.
